categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Labeled P2P and changes peer disconnection logic in src/net_processing.cpp during block relay.
categories.rationale: Prevents spurious disconnects of well-behaving peers during block downloads over slow connections. As noted in the problem statement, peers prioritizing block responses over pings can trigger the 20-minute ping timeout and get dropped despite behaving correctly.

categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Only adds a domain-specific P2P functional test and registers it in test_runner.py, rather than changing general test framework machinery.
categories.rationale: Tests of a specific subsystem belong to that subsystem rather than test infrastructure.
